The Oregon Trail was originally developed by Don Rawitsch, Bill Heinemann, and Paul Dillenberger as an educational, text-adventure game to teach school children about the realities of 19th Century pioneer life on the Oregon Trail. The latest iteration - The Oregon Trail: Boom Town - is a a free-to-play Farmville-like mobile game.
